item.title: About
item.description: This page is being redesigned to avoid repeating the homepage. The homepage now carries my short profile, skills, photo, and current focus. I plan to use this page for a more selective personal narrative: what problems I care about, how my academic and engineering interests connect, and what kind of collaborations or roles I am looking for.

item.title: Contact
item.description: Feel free to get in touch via email or social platforms. The contact form at the bottom of this page is also available; leave your name, email address, and message, and I can reply to you by email after receiving it. The form is powered by Formspree. Submitted messages are forwarded to the email address configured in the Formspree dashboard for this website. Address No.110 West, Yifu Building, Beijing Jiaotong University

item.title: Beijing Beijiufang Railway Traffic Technology Co., Ltd - Backend Project Intern
item.description: Beijing Beijiufang Railway Traffic Technology Co., Ltd. Apr 2025 - Jul 2025 Backend Project Intern Project Digital ticketing and knowledge-base system for railway vehicle inspection and maintenance. Tech Stack Spring Cloud, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JWT, MyBatis, MyBatis-Plus, MySQL, ECharts Responsibilities Developed authentication and authorization modules with Spring Security and JWT. Implemented ticket entry, search, upload, and data persistence modules. Connected backend data with visual dashboards for maintenance progress and issue summaries.

item.title: Beijing Heyicloud Technology Co., Ltd - Java Developer Intern
item.description: Beijing Heyicloud Technology Co., Ltd.
